demo.title: deposit.sh
demo.code:
# What Panda is, what it costs, the vaults
curl -s -X POST https://pandafinancial.org/api/agent/tools/get_panda_overview

# Build a $25 vault deposit for your wallet: unsigned, pre-simulated transactions come back
curl -s -X POST https://pandafinancial.org/api/agent/tools/build_vault_deposit \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"wallet":"0xYOUR_WALLET","amount_usdc":"25"}'
# -> steps: [{to, data, value, chainId: 8453}, ...]  sign and send them in order

# Check the position afterwards
curl -s -X POST https://pandafinancial.org/api/agent/tools/get_wallet_positions \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"wallet":"0xYOUR_WALLET"}'

setup: Install the skill with the button below (no key, no sign-up)
Fund your Bankr wallet with USDC and a little ETH for gas on Base
Say: "deposit $25 into a Panda vault" - the skill builds the transactions, you sign them
Say "check my Panda positions" any time; "earn interest on Morpho", "swap", "bridge" and "my Panda referral code" also work
The same tools are an MCP server at https://pandafinancial.org/mcp
